source_name: The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences

addressable_corpus_observation.note: Live OEIS sequence count observed during source audit; this is not an ingestion count for the pinned snapshot.

canonical_storage.note: JSONL is transient adapter interchange only; bulk persistent storage is Parquet outside Git.

fingerprints.source_record_sha256: snapshot + path + line number + complete %F source line
fingerprints.original_text_sha256: exact formula-field content after the OEIS field prefix
fingerprints.normalized_text_sha256: formula-field content with only surrounding/repeated whitespace canonicalized

materialization.reason: The current automation sandbox has no outbound Git/DNS path to acquire the pinned OEIS export and no Internet Archive credentials. The source adapter and source-agnostic Parquet/Internet Archive contract are materialized in the repository, but no bulk occurrence is claimed until an external executor completes and verifies the snapshot.
